edges.label: supports
edges.reason: Both reports state a death toll of 750 for the same event (Nepal-Tibet flash floods). They are from different publishers (France 24 and ABC News) and do not reference each other, indicating independent reporting.

edges.label: same_fact
edges.reason: The NEW quote 'more than 3,000' and the EXISTING quote '3,000' refer to the same figure in the context of a headline and body text of the same article.

edges.label: supports
edges.reason: Both sources state more than 3,000 people are missing. France 24 explicitly says 'more than 3,000 people remain missing' and ABC News says 'more than 3,000 missing'.

edges.label: supports
edges.reason: Both sources state 3,000 people are missing in the context of the Nepal glacial collapse/flood. France 24 says '3,000 missing' and ABC News says 'more than 3,000 missing', which are treated as equivalent values for the purpose of this slot.

edges.sentence: On 2026-08-30, ABC News reported “The death toll from last week's flash flooding disaster in the Nepal-Tibet border region rose to at least 750 people as of Sunday, according to the latest updates from Nepali and Chinese officials.”; on the same day, France 24 reported “The latest figures following Wednesday’s flash floods put the death toll at 750”.

On 2026-08-30, ABC News reported “Nepal-Tibet flood death toll rises to 750, officials say, more than 3,000 missing”; on the same day, France 24 reported “Nepal: Glacial collapse leaves 3,000 missing”.
On 2026-08-30, ABC News reported “Nepal-Tibet flood death toll rises to 750, officials say, more than 3,000 missing”; on the same day, France 24 reported “more than 3,000 people remain missing.”.
On 2026-08-30, France 24 reported “Nepal: Glacial collapse leaves 3,000 missing”; on the same day, France 24 reported “more than 3,000 people remain missing.”.
